summary: P7's inventory rewrite checks out against the filesystem it describes: the nine out-of-repo copies, the ten-path md5sum block, the five baked copies and both moved ArgoCDTools paths are all true, and the Architecture repo is declared. Three advisory findings ride along — declaring that repo adds a setup step that fails at every pod start because its manifest needs a `modern-app` tool container this environment does not have, and two statements newly written into the rotation runbook (the homelab root reaching architecture.webathome.org, and the eleven-path `find` cross-check) are false.

findings.summary: Declaring pvginkel/Architecture in repos: adds a pod-start setup step that fails on every environment start — its project.yaml runs every setup statement in a `modern-app` tool container this environment does not declare (witnessed: `cd /work/Architecture && kc project setup` exits 1).
step-ca-root-rotation.md:76 says the baked homelab root is how a run reaches https://architecture.webathome.org, which serves a Let's Encrypt leaf; the root is only what gets helm to charts.home.
step-ca-root-rotation.md:67-68's reassurance that a `find` returns eleven paths omits the canonical copy the same section names — the search returns twelve.
